patch_description:
Introduce a lightweight mid-block shared Z-phase layer (periphery vs center) immediately after a compact entangler set, and replace the center spokes with a shared parametrized CRZ entangler. The block keeps symmetry-aware shared RY initializations and a compact shared RX mixing on the periphery to remain parameter-efficient (9 parameters per block, unchanged total count). Structural changes:
- Added a shared mid-block RZ pair ("rz_block_periphery", "rz_block_center") to break parity and improve expressivity without increasing depth much.
- Use fixed CZ ring entanglers on a symmetric subset and shared CRZ on all spokes (tunable center coupling) to better capture hub-periphery correlations.
- Keep shared periphery parameters for efficiency and reuse "ry_center" as the center mixing to reduce parameter count while enabling focused center control.
These changes aim to increase representational power where it matters (hub spokes + mid Z-phase) while maintaining low parameter count and moderate depth for better generalization and faster convergence.
